title: Keep the draft unit of measure and variant code when creating the purchase line
summary: Unit of measure and variant code on purchase draft lines now persist when creating the final purchase invoice line.
key_points: Moved unit of measure and variant code assignment to after No. and Item Reference validation
Validation now occurs through proper Validate calls to maintain Qty. per Unit of Measure consistency
Prevents unit of measure from being dropped or reset to item default during finalization
Invalid unit of measure now triggers e-document error context instead of silent default
Comprehensive test coverage added for the scenario
quote: Moved both to after the No. and Item Reference validations, through Validate so Qty. per Unit of Measure stays right.
